title: Closest Pair Sum
statement: Given numbers sorted in ascending order and a target, return the smallest possible distance |nums[i] + nums[j] - target| over pairs i < j.

examples.explanation: 6 + 6 is not allowed; 4 + 9 = 13 and 6 + 9 = 15, so the distance is 1.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers from both ends, moving toward the target
keyPoints: If the sum is below the target move left, if above move right, if equal return 0

hints: Every pair is O(n^2). How does the sorted order help?
Start from both ends and look at the sum.
A sum below the target needs a bigger left value; above needs a smaller right value.
